text:
morgan: Heads up — seen ~200 audit rows where `api_key_scope` is `masked` after last night's KMS rewrap. Happens for embeddings routes only, seems tied to private customers using our rewrap job.

tara: ugh. any quick log snippet?

morgan: paste snippet:
```
{ "time":"2026-03-19T02:14:33Z", "route":"/v1/embeddings", "api_key_id":"key_...", "api_key_scope":"masked", "kms_key_tag":"removed" }
```

sahil: can you confirm if the wrap/unwrap flow strips tags? rewrap should preserve tags in metadata store

morgan: checked rewrap job logs — shows `SetKeyMetadata(key, {})` in node 3, looks like emptying tags.

tara: is this why token-introspection returns no scope mapping? we rely on kms tag to map token -> scope for private tokens right?

devsec-bot: [alert] Incident INF-2026-03-19-03: audit-log missing scope metadata for private KMS rewrap. Incident ticket created: https://go/incidents/INF-2026-03-19-03

lee: mitigation suggestion: fallback to authz-cache lookup before writing audit row. If mapping missing, write row with `scope:unknown` but include `api_key_id` and `token_hash` so we can backfill

morgan: I've reproduced locally with a small rewrap script. Reproducer:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://private.example.com/v1/embeddings -d '{...}'
# then run `rerun-rewrap --key key_foo --strip-tags`
```

sahil: short term patch: stop stripping tags in rewrap; longer: add unit test to ensure TagCopy() call

tara: also audit logging change: include raw `api_key_id` and a hashed `token_fingerprint` field so PII not stored but backfill possible

morgan: OK creating PR to add guard and test + hotfix to rewrap job. Will also add 24h ephemeral map for mapping during rotation. Assigning to @sahil and @lee. ETA 4h for hotfix.

lee: file postmortem stub in incidents channel once hotfix done. good catch :thumbsup:

morgan: thanks. I'll update the incident ticket and link PR.
